answer: A network that pays per identity must price identity itself. One chip, one identity: the attestation quote is checked at registration and re-checked every 9 epochs, and a quote reused across keys burns both seats. Buying 740 chips for 740 fakes costs more than the farm could ever earn back. One device, one identity — the binding cannot be copied to a second key. The gale test is the live device, the violet test is the locked stake, and the basalt test is the graded history no template can fake. Honest agents barely notice; farms go broke trying.
